title: The Financial Consequences of Legalized Sports Gambling
authors: Brett Hollenbeck; Poet Larsen; Davide Proserpio
eligible_reason: Staggered state legalization of sports betting mapped to a county-quarter panel. Binary absorbing treatment (implied by cohort variables first_treat_time / online_treat_time), 13 adoption cohorts with large never-treated groups for both the General Access and Retail-to-Online designs. Every main result is a Callaway-Sant'Anna estimate (did::att_gt, not-yet-treated controls, doubly robust, no covariates, county-population weights, county clustering) aggregated to a simple ATT (Table 4, 5, 11, 13, 14) or an event study (Figures 3, 5, 6). Explicitly reported CSA estimates of a qualifying design are eligible under PROTOCOL Section 2; TWFE counterparts can be built from the same panel. Table 12 adds two time-invariant pre-period county covariates (borderline, flagged).
design_notes: Unit: anonymized county (numeric_state_county), 3,104 counties. Time: quarter index 1-30 (data run roughly 2016Q1-2023Q2; exact calendar mapping not in README). Two designs: General Access (gname first_treat_time = min(retail, online) launch; control = not-yet-treated incl. 1,269 never-legalizing counties) and Retail-to-Online Access (gname online_treat_time; sample restricted to counties in states that first had retail betting, rto_main_subset; control = not-yet-online plus 498 retail-only counties; quarters 9-30). Outcomes are county means from the UC Consumer Credit Panel, 'transformed to avoid revealing actual levels' (values look demeaned; additive transforms do not affect ATTs). Weights num_individs_2015. No regression with an explicit 0/1 treatment column exists in the code: the binary indicator must be constructed as 1[gname>0 & time>=gname]. Hazard models (Table 3) and balance tests (Tables 2, 9, 10) are not DiD specifications.
n_eligible_specs_note: 12 static Table 4 + 12 Figure 3 event studies + 2 collections margins + 18 Table 5 + 12 Table 11 + 12 Figure 5 + 6 Table 12 (borderline) + 12 Table 13 + 6 Table 14 + 6 Figure 6. Main-text status of Tables 11-14 and Figures 5-6 could not be verified without the article; table numbering is continuous so they are probably main text.
n_adoption_cohorts_note: General Access: 13 first-treatment quarters (10,11,12,15,16,17,18,20,21,23,24,27,29) with 1,269 never-treated counties. RTO: 14 online quarters in the full data, 13 within the RTO sample (11,12,14,15,16,18,21,23,24,25,27,28,29) with 498 never-online counties. State-level COVID file: 13 cohorts, 9 never-treated states.
